operational_measure: Expected-signature matching in generator-known operation vocabulary
audit_finding: Aligned labels and primitives can reward rediscovery of known operations; does not establish open-ended semantic invariants
redesign_requirement: Use blinded/independent annotations or explicitly restrict claim to operation signature detection

operational_measure: Frequency x consistency x generality; generality bounded to observed program/task buckets
audit_finding: Could measure recurrence/fit rather than usefulness; early small-candidate relation not replicated in corrected 13D
redesign_requirement: Separate recurrence from predictive usefulness; validate on held-out future outcomes

operational_measure: Composite of reuse, abstraction, transfer and cost variables
audit_finding: Associated in one pool; frequency and p_reuse as strong or stronger; selection all-accepts
redesign_requirement: Predict independent future utility and show incremental policy value against simpler scores

operational_measure: Simulator utility accumulated from task outcomes and costs
audit_finding: Depends on task mix, cost model, and observed opportunities
redesign_requirement: Report success, reuse count, cost, and utility components separately; calibrate cost pre-run

operational_measure: Correct skill/application outcomes on covered generated tasks
audit_finding: Transfer bounded by source skill coverage and shared generator; missing components make some cells unavailable
redesign_requirement: Define near/far/structural categories before outcomes; require source coverage; keep unavailable distinct

operational_measure: Phase-specific task/skill utility on transfer split
audit_finding: Comparator and cost dependent; does not equal generalization or broad transfer
redesign_requirement: Freeze utility formula and task-level exactness; report raw correctness and costs

operational_measure: Success-gated simulator step reduction / replaced steps
audit_finding: A valid simulator step proxy; not wall-clock, FLOPs, or solver search effort
redesign_requirement: Use proxy name; do not claim compute savings; add actual resource measures only if separately instrumented

operational_measure: Weighted skill utility, transfer, coverage, composition score
audit_finding: 13E one capability persists and score/member evidence changes; not count/breadth itself
redesign_requirement: Validate against independent future behavior and keep object count separate

operational_measure: Change in internal C_t per round, first round from zero
audit_finding: 13E positive but initialization-sensitive; 13D mean negative; may reflect score accumulation
redesign_requirement: Test predictive relation to independent capability outcome; separate initial formation from later growth

operational_measure: Coverage over fixed synthetic family labels
audit_finding: Generator-specific four-family coverage; not open-world breadth
redesign_requirement: Define independent capability taxonomy and report raw task/family breadth

operational_measure: Weighted composite of CGR, transfer, utility, coverage, composition growth
audit_finding: Formula of internal measures; no external intelligence validation
redesign_requirement: Do not label intelligence until independent predictive/construct validation

audit_finding: Derived from IG; means mask non-monotonic round path
redesign_requirement: Validate against external future-learning outcome, not own components

audit_finding: Ratio proxy; declining trend does not independently mean cognitive efficiency fell
redesign_requirement: Relabel as formula ratio unless criterion validation succeeds

operational_measure: Schema validity flags and replay/order stability
audit_finding: Records can be valid while recording failed DSL search; only three successful discovery traces in 13G
redesign_requirement: Report schema validity, successful fit, stability, and semantic usefulness separately

operational_measure: Exact fit to demonstrations under full 10-program DSL scan
construct_risk: High if called semantic coverage; low if operationally labeled
audit_finding: Bounded program-family fits, not semantic ARC family or task accuracy
redesign_requirement: Report budget and full inventory; annotate taxonomy provenance; separate test exactness

operational_measure: All test outputs exact within scored candidate budget
construct_risk: Low operational / High external generalization risk
audit_finding: Correct metric for that bounded solver but 0/200 ASFT transfer and 1/200 holdout do not imply broad ARC impossibility
redesign_requirement: Report scored-arm candidate budget, attempts, split provenance, and official competition result separately

operational_measure: Task reward minus configured creation/reuse cost
audit_finding: Sensitive to frozen MC assumptions and opportunity counts
redesign_requirement: Report components and sensitivity; match task/budget exposure

operational_measure: Counts/typed capability objects and member changes
audit_finding: 13E has one persistent object; score/member changes do not equal emergent breadth
redesign_requirement: Use object-level counts/state/member records; require external behavioral validation
